inputs.label: NAOMI arcade set gunsur2
inputs.help: Your own NAOMI World cartridge set gunsur2.zip and the BIOS set naomi.zip. Leave them zipped.

steps.text: Open Survivor 2 Code: Veronica VR from Library > Unknown Sources. Move with the left thumbstick and snap-turn with the right thumbstick.

notes: Releases also carry a PCVR zip and a source zip; the asset pattern takes only the Quest APK.
